svg.desc: Throughput: 3.57M tokens / min, one trn2.48xlarge on AgentX, decode batch 12; Decode Step: 24 ms at 8 users, down from 34 ms, with NKI megakernels; Long Context: 1M tokens, first token in 190.8 s, a cached follow-up in 1.84 s; Cost: $0.040 per M tokens, at the $8.60/h spot price; $0.167 on a capacity block
